name: Oceanid Mimic
description:
There are 3 kinds of Oceanid Mimics in total, and up 2 kinds can exist at once:
Squirrel: Deal 2 Hydro DMG at the End Phase. 2 Usages.
Raptor: Deal 1 Hydro DMG at the End Phase. 3 Usages.
Frog: Can take 1 DMG for active character. 1 Usage. Once this effect is depleted, deal 2 Hydro DMG during the End Phase.
